plan.design: Score all 904 candidate lines with the rice_gs Ridge model (rank_candidates) to obtain E1 predictions of GRWT100. Then spend the 20-query E3 oracle budget on the highest-model-ranked lines (the set most likely to contain the true maximum), plus a small number of lower-ranked control lines to check calibration. Compare measured vs predicted to confirm enrichment and identify the measured maximum among queried lines.
controls: A few lower-ranked (e.g., ~100th-200th percentile by prediction) control lines are queried to verify that high predictions are enriched for high measured GRWT100. Model rankings are E1
only oracle values are E3. Single environment
plan.observation_metric: Measured GRWT100 (g/100 grains) from the oracle vs model-predicted GRWT100; rank correlation and whether the highest measured value falls among the top model-ranked candidates.
plan.refutation_condition: If the highest-measured line among the top model-ranked candidates is not distinguishable from/less than control lines, or if measured vs predicted rank correlation is near zero or negative, then the model ranking is not informative for the maximum and the ranking must not be trusted.
